en.t: In this way, I went on to university.

units.source_text: 但是，不等于说一切都因此而了结。

en.t: But that did not mean everything had been settled because of it.

units.source_text: 老师这种态度，依然没有说明任何问题。

en.t: The teacher's attitude still explained nothing at all.

units.source_text: 即使是继承人的问题，也不知道他有什么打算，完全摸不着头脑。

en.t: Even regarding the matter of a successor, I had no idea what he intended and was completely at a loss.
